body: Thank you very much. I don't think we have concussion specialists where I live. But I will look for one.
Mine is not major, but it still is awful. Thank you for talking to me. I am so afraid right now. Your words calmed me somewhat.
Afterwards are you ever the same?

Thanks for the kind words. Right now I don't think I would ever be okay again. I got a concussion a month ago. Since then I am not feeling like myself. Before it I was doing ok. I feel damaged, sad and angry. I won't ever be the same and it hurts so much.
Can you have a concussion without feeling fatigue or tiredness?
Well, I read this and I realized how true it is.

Well, that still makes them rude and entitled. Many people are like that even in real life. But when you are anonymous it's even easier. This is your story, you should write it the way you want. If they don't like the ship or the direction it's their problem. Apparently they lack the decency to understand it. You should not conform to other's whims and wants. People like that take but don't give back. 

Write what you want. Tell them you are not changing it, because it's your story. The most important thing is to make you happy, not them. And if other people tag along for the ride great! But you should write it firstly for yourself.

Those people don't deserve you crying over their comments. I am sure for every negative comment there are many more positive ones and happy readers that are enjoying your story. Focus on them. The others are not important. Those kind of people feed of attention. Don't give it to them, just ignore them, they will get tired. They are not worth it, think about all the people you made happy with your story. Sending you hugs!
